[[File:Assunta.png|thumb|250px|Assunta and Ritchie]] '''Assunta''' (Japanese: '''サユリ''' ''Sayuri'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP080|Friends to the End]]''. She battled [[Ritchie]] in the first [[Full Battle]] of the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]]. After a fierce battle, both {{pkmn|Trainer}}s ended up with only one Pokémon left. Using her {{p|Ivysaur}}, Assunta was able to overpower Ritchie's {{p|Pikachu}}, [[Sparky]], and win the match, much to the shock of {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. With this win she advanced to the semifinals. It is unknown what happened to Assunta after this point, but the silhouette of the second-place League winner at the end of the episode greatly resembles her, indicating that she might have made it to the final battle but lost. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Assunta |pkmn=Rhydon |type1=Ground |type2=Rock |img=Assunta Rhydon.png |epnum=EP080 |epname=Friends to the End |desc=Assunta's {{p|Rhydon}} appeared in ''[[EP080|Friends to the End]]'', where it battled Ritchie for a place in the semifinals of the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]]. It was first seen battling [[Zippo]], dodging its {{m|Flamethrower}}. It is unknown if it won or lost to Zippo. None of Rhydon's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Assunta |pkmn=Venomoth |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Assunta Venomoth.png |epnum=EP080 |epname=Friends to the End |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Assunta's {{p|Venomoth}} appeared in ''[[EP080|Friends to the End]]'', where it battled Ritchie for a place in the semifinals of the Indigo Plateau Conference. It was seen battling {{DL|Ritchie|Happy}}, using {{m|Whirlwind}} against it. It is unknown if it won or lost to Happy. Venomoth's only known move is {{m|Whirlwind}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Assunta |pkmn=Ivysaur |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Assunta Ivysaur.png |epnum=EP080 |epname=Friends to the End |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Assunta's {{p|Ivysaur}} appeared in ''[[EP080|Friends to the End]]'', where it battled Ritchie for a place in the semifinals of the Indigo Plateau Conference. It was the last Pokémon Assunta had left, and as such, it battled [[Sparky]]. Ivysaur instantly charged towards Sparky, then used {{m|Vine Whip}}, knocking the {{p|Pikachu}} off its feet. Sparky used {{m|Thunder Shock}}, but it failed to hit. Ivysaur hit Sparky with a powerful {{m|Solar Beam}} followed by a {{m|Tackle}}, fainting Sparky and giving Assunta the win. Ivysaur's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Vine Whip}}, and {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Spearow or Tentacool |type1=??? |img=Ritchie Assunta Spearow.png |img2=Ritchie Assunta Tentacool.png |epnum=EP080 |epname=Friends to the End |desc=Assunta had at least three other Pokémon during the Indigo Plateau Conference, as they conduct [[Full Battle]]s. It is uncertain which ones belonged to her, but she owns either {{p|Spearow}} or {{p|Tentacool}}. None of Spearow's moves are known.
